sloka: यत् कर्तव्यं मनुष्येण धर्षणां परिमार्जता ।तत् कृतं सकलं सीते शत्रुहस्तादमर्षणात् ।। ६.११८.१३ ।।
transliteration: yat kartavyaṁ manuṣyeṇa dharṣaṇāṁ parimārjatā ।tat kṛtaṁ sakalaṁ sīte śatruhastādamarṣaṇāt ।। 6.118.13 ।।

translations.english: "That which my mind desired as a duty of a human being, to get rid of the insult has been done by killing Ravana."
